name: design-review
description: Always-on discipline for critiquing a design proposal before or during implementation: confirm persistence/ordering tradeoffs in prose before re-implementing, name a reversed design principle before implementing it, check a mitigation's own failure mode and retry-compounding, split durability guarantees per piece of state, propagate a fix to every parallel representation, don't let a reversal path assume the forward action completed, verify ordering consistency across similar flows, read sibling idempotency guards as design-intent evidence, grep implementers/call-sites before judging refactor risk, check a sibling write endpoint for the same scoping bug, and derive synthetic version keys from content hashes not timestamps.

source.title: Design Review Baseline
source.relationship: New baseline created 2026-09-01 from the baseline-gap-review skill's occurrence #2 pass over _Improvements — 11 principles from a single intense one-shot design-feedback session (EpinServer T&C reliability hardening) that didn't fit verification-epistemics's claim-verification scope or any other existing pack.
